description: Bornes-fontaines is a dataset listed in Boulogne-Billancourt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Bornes-fontaines gérées par GPSO sur le Territoire Une borne-fontaine est un équipement public et collectif permettant de mettre a disposition de l'eau potable Retrouvez le jeu de données des fontaines et bassins d'ornement ici. Coverage: Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal files it under Environnement, Cadre de vie. Its keywords are Eau, Fontaines, Bornes fontaines. The portal shows 66 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-boulognebillancourt-seineouest-portal.
